description: Two neuron circuits and two difference rectifiers on one panel, with no connection between any of the four

params.text: Adds a steady 0V to 5V into that neuron's mix before the mix is rectified
Sets the size of the comparator swing, 1V to 10V; that much is taken off the rectified mix while the mix is above 0V and added to it while it is not

inputs.text: One of three signals summed into that neuron; the sum plus SNS is clamped to 0V to 10V before the comparator swing is applied
Summed with the other minus jack of that rectifier, and the total taken away from the plus pair
Summed with the other plus jack of that rectifier, and the minus pair taken away from the total

outputs.text: That neuron's rectified mix with the comparator swing applied
The plus pair less the minus pair of that rectifier while the difference is negative, down to -10V, and 0V at any other time
The plus pair less the minus pair of that rectifier while the difference is positive, up to 10V, and 0V at any other time

notes: with nothing patched and SNS fully anticlockwise, each neuron output rests at whatever its RSPNS knob is set to: the comparator swings negative whenever the mix is not above 0V.
the two neurons and the two rectifiers share nothing inside the module; the interaction the panel drawing suggests comes from patching one section's output into another's input.
